reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: the only penalty mechanic (§7.3 b), p0757) and the late-shipment premium cost obligation (p0861) run against MSL (the vendor), which the rule expressly treats as compliant.

No liquidated damages, stipulated penalty or minimum/exit fee payable by IBM as customer appears in the cited text; p0722 preserves IBM's right to cancel Purchase Orders at any time with cost reimbursement only (actual costs, not a stipulated sum), and p0927/p0930 place unused-flexibility and untransferred EOL inventory risk on MSL.

Consistent with the compliant status, no redline was rendered (paragraphs are byte-identical to the originals) and no counterparty comment was added, so there is no over-flagging or unnecessary negotiation ask; deterministic checks returned no issues.

Rationale accurately characterises the clauses and correctly notes cost reimbursement is distinguishable from a liquidated amount; finding is retained as internal evidence rather than raised as an issue, which is the correct handling.
